attributes.action: Install air conditioning on all public transport in the UK
attributes.additional_details:
Public transport in the UK regularly becomes extremely hot and uncomfortable during warmer months, particularly during heatwaves. With rising temperatures linked to climate change, this issue is becoming more serious each year.
Overheating in confined public transport spaces can lead to dehydration, dizziness, fainting, and in extreme cases, medical emergencies. It can also discourage people from using public transport, pushing them toward private car use and increasing congestion and emissions
attributes.background: We ask the UK Government to introduce a legal requirement for all public transport vehicles in the UK, including buses, trains, and underground services — to be fitted with effective air conditioning systems that are properly maintained and operational during warm weather.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Mandate working a/c and heating systems on all new public transport vehicles" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771285
